create.name: Renee Sills
create.bio:
Renee Sills is an astrologer, somatic movement educator and artist in Portland, Oregon, and the founder of Embodied Astrology, an online learning community. Astrology came to Renee early: their mother wove it into her own work with the body, and Renee began studying movement and somatics as a child. They have taught movement since 2004, co-founded and helped run a yoga therapeutics training school from 2013 to 2018, and hold credentials as a somatic movement educator and a registered yoga therapist, along with art degrees from Concordia University and Portland State University. They have given astrology consultations professionally since 2014.

The heart of the work is reading the chart through the body. Signs and planets are approached as sensations, postures and patterns of energy that can be felt and moved, not only interpreted on paper. Each Monday Renee leads Somatic Space, a live online class of breath, gentle movement and visualisation tuned to the week's astrology, and at the start of every zodiac season they record free horoscopes for all twelve signs. Embodied Astrology also runs a membership with study groups and guest-led workshops, and an associated podcast.

courses.title: Somatic Space Classes
courses.description: A weekly live class on Zoom every Monday morning (Pacific time), mixing gentle movement, breath and visualisation with a look at the astrology of the coming week. You can drop in to a live class or buy the latest recording afterwards on a sliding scale.
courses.price: Recording from $10 USD (sliding scale $10–$30 USD); live drop-in price shown at booking

courses.title: Embodied Astrology Membership
courses.description: Monthly membership giving live access to Renee's weekly Somatic Space classes and the full archive of recordings, plus monthly live horoscope sessions, peer-led study groups and a private online community. Scholarships are offered and it can be cancelled at any time.

free_resources.title: Renee Sills on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Free guided meditations and short talks blending body awareness, intuition and astrology, including movement-based practices. Open to anyone in the app or a web browser.

free_resources.title: Free Seasonal Horoscopes
free_resources.description: At the start of each zodiac season Renee records an audio horoscope for every sign, with a written transcript, readable by sun, moon or rising sign. The page is refreshed each season and costs nothing.

sprint.tier_evidence: Insight Timer 4.5k (profile, 1 Nov 2026); Instagram 47K (og:description of instagram.com/embodiedastrology, which names Renee Sills, 1 Nov 2026); YouTube 3.3K (channel header next to @embodiedastrology, 1 Nov 2026) → ~54.8k total → local_hero
flags: Email is the Embodied Astrology office inbox (published as a mailto link on the ethics page); the contact form also goes to the office coordinator.
Instagram and YouTube are under the Embodied Astrology brand name, counted because the Instagram account names Renee Sills and the brand is her own project; the site also hosts guest teachers.
Pronouns: the site's team page uses they/them, the older About page and Insight Timer use she/her; the bio uses they/them and mostly the name. A human may want to confirm.

Health: her readings page describes using medical astrology to see how clients' bodies are affected, and her course Your Chart is a Body teaches bodily rulerships and 'common symptoms'; both left out. Several popular Insight Timer tracks are condition-led (addiction, trauma responses, brain relaxation); covered only by the profile link. The brand itself is not sold on conditions, but a human may want to confirm she passes the strict health rule.

Political check: the site carries social-justice language and guest workshops (e.g. one on the Combahee River Raid), and an interview elsewhere is titled 'Embodiment is inherently political'; her own YouTube titles are all seasonal horoscopes, so not mainly partisan, but worth a look.
Two photos only, both from her own site; the second is an artistic shot with eyes closed.
left_out: YouTube: every upload is a dated monthly or seasonal horoscope, so no evergreen videos listed.
Your Chart is a Body ($350 USD course): course copy covers bodily rulerships and 'common symptoms and presentations'; borderline health, left out.
Embodied Astrology Readings: by application only, very limited, and described through a medical-astrology lens.
Guest-led drop-in workshops (Aziz Bisanz, Cameron Allen and others) and dated expanded year-ahead readings: not Renee's own evergreen offerings.
Insight Timer: no courses on her profile; tracks covered by the profile link.
Embodied Astrology podcast: no fitting resource type; mentioned in the bio. No books found.
